title: OMENLY
tagline: A small arcade. Made by hand. Play in a browser.

games.title: ECHO
games.blurb: The lights are gone. Ping to listen and run when they ping back. Five things hunt you in the dark: a stalker, a howler, a hunter, a tank, a whisperer. Manage your battery, descend deeper.
games.controls: WASD + click + F/X (desktop) - joystick + PING + FLASH/EMP (mobile)

games.title: Porchlight
games.blurb: One Halloween. Six porches. A small American street, a half-full pillowcase, and a few small choices that stay with you.

games.title: Ashenreach
games.blurb: Twenty-three years after the fire, you walk back into the valley. Five names to find. One altar. Things in the dark that did not leave.

games.title: Stillhunt
games.blurb: Dawn on the ridge. Mist in the hollows. Six shells in your pocket. A bolt-action hunting shooter in pseudo-3D.
games.controls: mouse + click / SPACE (desktop) - joystick + FIRE button (mobile)

games.title: Blacksite
games.blurb: A CIA ghost in a hostile facility. Steal the intel. Stay out of the cones. Crouch and they do not hear you, usually.

games.title: gaymesbond: last darkness
games.blurb: A third-person 3D stealth comedy spy parody rebuilt around one large sunlit open-island mission. Blend through crowds, dodge guards, cameras, and lasers, then use darts, glitter decoys, smoke, charm, hacks, and velvet takedowns to steal classified nonsense.
games.controls: WASD + mouse + SHIFT + E/F/Q/SPACE/C/M (desktop) - joystick + look + ACT/DART/DECOY/SMOKE/CHARM (mobile)

games.title: Raccoon
games.blurb: Raccoon City opens into a larger staged survival route: knife and katana stealth kills, guns, rockets, jungle trails, animals, waterfalls, vehicles, fuse-relay puzzles, and a cinematic extraction.
games.controls: WASD + mouse + click + F stealth/use (desktop) - joystick + look + FIRE/USE (mobile)

games.title: Dinorift
games.blurb: A bloody dinosaur survival shooter in a jungle rift. Fight raptors, armored trikes, spitters, and tyrant rex waves with spear launcher, rifle, grenades, and rockets.
games.controls: WASD + mouse + click + 1-4 + R (desktop) - dual sticks + FIRE + weapon buttons (mobile)

games.title: Siteline
games.blurb: A 5v5 bombsite FPS in your browser. Three maps, 28 buyable weapons, knife, armor, HE, flash, smoke, molotov, incendiary, decoy, room-code multiplayer up to 50 players, or solo CPU bots.
games.controls: WASD + mouse + click + R/G/F/B (desktop) - joystick + FIRE + side buttons (mobile)

games.title: Graveyard Shift
games.blurb: A legally distinct 3D slasher tag parody with singleplayer bots and lightweight room-code multiplayer. Repair generators, rescue teammates, drop pallets, stun the killer, open the gate, or play killer and conduct mandatory feedback.
games.controls: WASD + mouse + E/Q/R/click (desktop) - gamepad + mobile sticks/buttons

games.title: Brick Vice: Sunset Nonsense
games.blurb: A GTA-style open-city parody with solo play and room-code co-op. Mason Brick runs jobs through neon streets, while a second player can join as Foccoia Bread for supercar theft, yacht-row errands, bike jumps, swamp cash, cops, and hip-hop loading-screen energy.

games.title: Girth
games.blurb: A ridiculous first-person garden gag: rub the magic log, build friction, splash water, grow flowers, and get the big fertile payoff.
games.controls: drag left-right / tap and rub (mobile) - A/D or arrows (desktop)

games.title: Nocturne
games.blurb: A pixel-noir whodunit. One apartment floor. Five neighbours. One killer. Knock, listen, watch what they do through the keyhole. Lock three tells in your notebook and accuse before dawn.

games.title: Rent Simulator
games.blurb: A month-by-month apartment survival sim. Work shifts, juggle stress and energy, pay rent, negotiate, handle repairs, and learn that attacking the landlord brings police fast.
